title: 16-Week Interview Plan
summary: Target: 500+ Problems  |  Daily: 2 hrs DSA + 1 hr System Design  |  Total Duration: ~16 Weeks

phases.Key Concepts: Arrays, Strings, Hashing, Two Pointers, Sliding Window
Linked Lists, Stacks, Queues, Monotonic Structures
Binary Trees, BST, Tries, Graph BFS/DFS, Union-Find
Heaps, Advanced Graphs, Intervals, Bit Manipulation
Hard DP, Advanced Trees, Segment Trees, Math

daily.What To Do: Re-read yesterday's notes, review 2–3 solved problems
Study concept deeply → understand intuition → code from scratch
Solve 2–4 problems on current topic (timed: 20–25 min each)
Study 1 SD concept + design a system end-to-end with trade-offs
daily.Notes: Use the SD sheet as checklist

daily.What To Do: Flag hard problems for re-attempt in 3/7/14 days

patterns.Recognize When…: Max/min subarray satisfying a constraint; 'longest substring with...'
patterns.Template / Approach: Expand right pointer always; shrink left when constraint violated; track window state with map/int
patterns.Key Problems: Min Window Substring, Longest Substring No Repeat, Fruit Into Baskets
patterns.Gotchas: Define precisely when to shrink; avoid over-shrinking

patterns.Recognize When…: Sorted array + pair/triplet sum; palindrome check; container problems
patterns.Template / Approach: lo=0, hi=n-1; move based on comparison to target; sort first if needed
patterns.Key Problems: 3Sum, Container With Water, Trapping Rain Water
patterns.Gotchas: Sort destroys index — use values; watch duplicate skipping in 3Sum

patterns.Recognize When…: Cycle detection, finding middle, kth from end
patterns.Template / Approach: slow=head, fast=head; slow moves 1, fast moves 2; check fast==slow for cycle
patterns.Key Problems: Linked List Cycle, Find Duplicate Number, Happy Number
patterns.Gotchas: For find duplicate: Floyd's cycle = detect, find entry = cycle start

patterns.Recognize When…: Shortest path in unweighted graph; level-by-level processing
patterns.Template / Approach: Queue with (node, dist/level); mark visited before enqueue not after dequeue
patterns.Key Problems: Word Ladder, Rotting Oranges, Shortest Path in Binary Matrix
patterns.Gotchas: Mark visited at enqueue time to avoid TLE

patterns.Template / Approach: Choose → recurse → unchoose; prune early; track current path
patterns.Gotchas: Draw decision tree first; add index param to avoid reuse

patterns.Recognize When…: Next Greater Element; temperatures; histogram rectangle
patterns.Template / Approach: Maintain decreasing stack; pop when current > stack top; record answer at pop time
patterns.Key Problems: Daily Temperatures, Largest Rect Histogram, Trapping Rain Water
patterns.Gotchas: Know whether to store index vs value in stack

patterns.Recognize When…: 'Minimum maximum' or 'Maximum minimum'; feasibility function exists
patterns.Template / Approach: lo=min_val, hi=max_val; binary search; write isValid(mid) function
patterns.Key Problems: Koko Eating Bananas, Split Array Largest Sum, Capacity to Ship
patterns.Gotchas: isValid() must be monotonic; think about lo/hi edge cases

patterns.Recognize When…: Kth largest/smallest; K most frequent; K closest
patterns.Template / Approach: Min-heap of size K for Kth largest; pop when size>K; heap top = answer
patterns.Key Problems: Kth Largest, K Closest Points, Top K Frequent, Find Median Stream
patterns.Gotchas: Min-heap for top-K largest (counter-intuitive); max-heap for Kth smallest

patterns.Recognize When…: Include/exclude decision; optimal value with constraint
patterns.Template / Approach: dp[i] = max/min considering first i items; dp[i] = max(dp[i-1], dp[i-w]+val)
patterns.Key Problems: 0/1 Knapsack, Coin Change, House Robber, Partition Equal Subset
patterns.Gotchas: Traverse inner loop backwards for 0/1 (avoid reuse)

patterns.Recognize When…: LCS, Edit Distance, Interleaving — comparing two strings/arrays
patterns.Template / Approach: dp[i][j] = answer for s1[:i] and s2[:j]; fill row by row
patterns.Key Problems: LCS, Edit Distance, Regex Match, Distinct Subsequences
patterns.Gotchas: Define dp[0][j] and dp[i][0] base cases carefully

patterns.Recognize When…: Connected components; dynamic connectivity; cycle in undirected graph
patterns.Template / Approach: find() with path compression; union() with rank; detect cycle if find(u)==find(v) before union
patterns.Key Problems: Redundant Connection, Number of Islands II, Accounts Merge
patterns.Gotchas: Always implement both path compression AND union by rank

patterns.Template / Approach: TrieNode has children[26] and isEnd; insert char by char; search/startsWith iterate
patterns.Key Problems: Implement Trie, Word Search II, Design Search Autocomplete
patterns.Gotchas: Use HashMap<Character, TrieNode> for flexible char sets

patterns.Recognize When…: Dependency ordering; course scheduling; build order
patterns.Template / Approach: BFS (Kahn's): in-degree array + queue; DFS: post-order reversal
patterns.Key Problems: Course Schedule I/II, Alien Dictionary, Task Scheduler
patterns.Gotchas: Cycle = no valid topological order; check result size == V

patterns.Recognize When…: Shortest path in weighted graph with non-negative weights
patterns.Template / Approach: Min-heap (dist, node); relax neighbors; skip stale entries
patterns.Key Problems: Network Delay Time, Cheapest Flights K Stops, Path With Min Effort
patterns.Gotchas: Does NOT work with negative edges; use Bellman-Ford then

patterns.Template / Approach: Sort by start; if curr.start <= prev.end → merge (update end); else add to result
patterns.Key Problems: Merge Intervals, Non-Overlapping Intervals, Meeting Rooms II
patterns.Gotchas: Sort by start for merge; sort by end for greedy scheduling
